senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (Ἐμμαούς, Ἀμμαούς, hellenized form of חמה, חמתה) Emmaus, Ammaus, a town in the plain of Judæa (or Philistæa), renowned, in Talmudic days, for its warm springs and luxurious life.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:7">Koh. R. to VII, 7</cite>, a. e. [<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11">Ib. 11</cite> <he>אימוניס</he> prob. <he>אימאוס</he>.] Cmp. <cite ref="D00630"><he>דימסית</he></cite>. [Other forms: <cite ref="P00853"><he>עמאוס</he></cite>, <he>עמיס</he>, <he>אמאום</he>, <he>עמאים</he>. For other places by that name, v. Neub. Géogr. p. 100.]
